national.summary: BBWS Pemali Juana mengeruk sedimentasi di Kanal Banjir Barat Semarang sepanjang 1,3 kilometer. Upaya ini menjaga kapasitas sungai dan mengurangi risiko banjir.

international.title: US army postpones plan to detonate bomb-making chemical amid outcry
international.summary: The controlled detonation can lead to a plume containing lead particles, worrying residents and state officials The US army has delayed its plan to detonate a stash of bomb-making chemicals in south-eastern Iowa as questions swirl about the public health risks. The army was set to blow up about 5 tons of lead azide in Middletown, Iowa, at noon on Friday, a move it described as the safest way to dispose of the highly sensitive compound. Continue reading...

international.title: More climate money for Africa? Europe says use what's already pledged
